positions_4hz_conversion.t: bucket start in ms on the replay clock (time_ms // 250 * 250)
positions_4hz_conversion.selection: last native observation in each 250 ms bucket, per player; no interpolation, buckets with no observation are absent
positions_4hz_conversion.xyz: native world units rounded to the nearest integer, int16, no scale and no offset; out of range fails the shard
positions_4hz_conversion.yaw_cd: native yaw degrees x 100 rounded, uint16, range 0 to 36000, source wraparound unchanged
positions_4hz_conversion.missing: stored as null, never replaced by zero
